subject: [PATCH 04/60] mm/page_alloc: build zonelists from common memory

reviews.author: Gregory Price (Meta)
reviews.summary: The original author's root message, which presents the patch and its changes without any discussion or review.

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch refactors the zonelist building code in mm/page_alloc.c to build fallback zonelists from common memory (N_MEMORY_COMMON) and __GFP_THISNODE zonelists only for common nodes. The build_local_zonelist() function is reused to build a local-only zonelist for nodes outside N_MEMORY_COMMON. This change aims to optimize allocation decisions by reducing the number of nodes considered for allocations.
